HYPOTHESIS: The dominant blocker is a post-complete-success NON-TERMINATION of the frozen candidate, and the maintained gate then masks it by discarding the evidence that proves the product passed. The decisive discriminator is budget accounting, which no prior dispatch in this Wave performed. The complete passing payload is written to disk at t=7.52s, 8.23s, 9.76s and 8.46s into the 25s deadline, leaving 17.48s, 16.77s, 15.24s and 16.54s of UNUSED budget. The artifact is therefore never short of time: it finished all of its work inside 10 seconds and was then given more than 15 further seconds to exit, and it did not. This falsifies the 'the 25s budget is too small for the smoke work' reading carried by run phase 158, restated in report section 24 and section 27, and it also falsifies the '240s makes it PASS' claim.
